title: Priv EKS Bootstrapping Inspector: Terraform module with safe upgrades & health assertions
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement a reusable Terraform module (module: priv_eks_inspector) that provisions the Redwood Private control plane EKS cluster with strong preflight validation, post-deploy health assertions, and safe in-place upgrade hooks. Goals: (1) make provisioning idempotent for repeated apply/plan cycles across accounts and regions; (2) include canary-friendly upgrade paths with automated health probes and rollback signals; (3) emit structured observability metadata (CloudWatch/Datadog tags + Prometheus metrics) required by Console and SRE runbooks; (4) expose policy knobs for autoscaling, KMS-integrated secrets, and network ACL prechecks for VPC endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module publishes versioned releases to our internal registry with semantic versioning
Module runs idempotently across repeated apply cycles with no destructive diffs for minor changes
Preflight checks detect common misconfigurations (missing routes, insufficient SG rules, missing KMS key policy) and fail-fast with actionable error messages
Upgrade hook supports canary node pool rollouts and emits success/failure signals to the control plane and to CI job

Health assertions (API server k8s control-plane endpoints, etcd quorum check, node readiness, certificate validity) run automatically post-provision and are visible in Console under cluster provisioning activity
Integration tests and a small end-to-end harness in the infra-ci pipeline validate a blue/green and a canary upgrade scenario
Security review checklist completed and documented in Confluence; KMS/HSM integration validated in staging
tasks: Design RFC: detailed input/output variables and state handling (Confluence link)
Module implementation: main.tf, variables.tf, outputs.tf, locals and examples
Preflight validations: implement as a terraform null_resource that runs a small Go binary (infra-inspector) to surface errors
Upgrade hooks: implement lifecycle hooks + automation that runs health assertions and sets canary signals
Observability: add logs/metrics/tags; wire to existing SRE dashboards
Policy: add example IAM/KMS policies and doc for customers
Tests: unit tests for plan diffs + infra-ci e2e pipeline scenario
Docs: guide for customers and internal runbook for failures and rollback

notes: This ticket aims to be the canonical terraform module for Private control plane bootstrapping. Keep the module API conservative to avoid churn for dependent repos. For major changes, follow deprecation policy and provide migration scripts.
implementation_decisions: Use a lightweight Go inspector binary invoked via terraform null_resource to avoid complex provider development
Prefer making stateful resources optional and behind flags to permit dry-run validations without mutating resources
Emit structured JSON logs to CloudWatch/Datadog and tag all resources with provisioner_run_id for traceability
